files.title: File:House at 950 Douglas Street, Vermilion.jpg
files.author: Nyttend
files.caption: Front and northern side of the house located at 950 Douglas Street in Vermilion, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1990, it occupies the site of the Old Vermilion Mill, which is listed on the National Register of Historic Places; it has not yet been removed from the Register, despite its destruction.
